title: Typical criteria for nitrification-denitrification systems (20°C MLSS temperature)

cell_spans.description: Printed section heading 'HRT, hours' spans the full table width
Printed section heading 'Dissolved oxygen, mg/l' spans the full table width

markdown:
| Parameter | Pre-denitrification | Post-denitrification | Combined Pre- and Post-denitrification |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| System SRT, days | 6-30 | 6-30 | 8-40 |
| HRT, hours |  |  |  |
| First anoxic zone | 2-8 | - | 2-6 |
| First aerobic zone | 6-12 | 6-12 | 6-12 |
| Second anoxic zone | - | 2-6 | 2-5 |
| Reaeration zone | - | - | 0.5-1.0 |
| MLSS, mg/l | 1500-4000 | 1500-4000 | 2000-5000 |
| Nitrate recycle | 2-4 Q* |  | 2-4 Q |
| RAS flow | 0.5-1 Q | 0.5-1 Q | 100% (Q design) |
| Dissolved oxygen, mg/l |  |  |  |
| Anoxic zones | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Aerobic zones | 1-4 | 1-4 | 1-4 |
| Mixing requirements |  |  |  |
| Anoxic zones, kw/10³m³ | 4-10 | 4-10 | 4-10 |
| Aerobic zones, kw/10³m³ | 20-40 | 20-40 | 20-40 |
| Airflow, aerobic, m³/min 10³ m³ | 10-30 | 10-30 | 10-40 |
notes: Printed immediately below the table: '* Energy input is an important parameter; however, the manufacturer should be consulted for determining the number and placement of mixers. Propeller and turbine mixers have been used successfully.'
The asterisk is attached to '2-4 Q*' in the Pre-denitrification cell only; the Combined column prints '2-4 Q' without an asterisk, and the Post-denitrification cell is empty. Retained exactly.

The footnote marked by the asterisk talks about mixer energy input, which reads as a note about the mixing requirements rows rather than about nitrate recycle. Retained as printed; no reading is imposed.

The running text below the table on the same page (dissolved oxygen assumptions and item a on oxygen demand of 4.57 mg O2/mgN with 2.86 mg O2/mgN released) is prose, not a displayed equation, and is not transcribed as a formula.
